businesses.business: cutting tools, first aid and safety products

offering_description.value: Supplies scissors, rulers, and cutting tools, first aid and safety kits, and outdoor/hunting knives and sharpeners. Sells mainly to retailers, safety distributors, and institutional customers. Products are largely sourced from contract manufacturers in Asia, with some own manufacturing.

primary_products.value: first aid kits and supplies; safety products; scissors and shears; rulers and measuring tools; knives and sharpeners

customer_segment.value: B2B: mass merchants, office and school supply retailers, safety distributors, industrial and workplace customers; B2C: consumers buying through retail and online stores

end_markets.value: workplace safety; first aid; school and office supplies; consumer and housewares; outdoor and sporting goods

revenue_model.value: product sales: first aid, cutting, measuring and outdoor products sold to retailers and distributors

value_chain_position.value: brand owner: designs and markets branded products sourced from contract manufacturers, sold to retailers and distributors; OEM / manufacturer: manufactures some first aid kits and products in own facilities

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, Europe, and Asia, with majority of sales in the US

specialization.value: related lines: first aid and safety, cutting tools, measuring tools, and outdoor knives sold to similar retail and distributor channels

distribution_channels.value: third-party retail: mass merchants, club stores, office and school supply retailers, hardware stores; distributors / dealers: safety and industrial distributors, first aid distributors; online: e-commerce retailers and own web sites

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: first aid products subject to FDA and OSHA/ANSI standards, import tariffs and product safety rules
